summary: Implemented the JSON pretty-printing feature. Changes: rich/highlighter.py (JSONHighlighter, base prefix "json.", one combined regex for brace, literals, number, str); rich/default_styles.py (six json.* styles); rich/json.py (JSON renderable with no_wrap=True and overflow=None on its Text, plus a __main__ CLI using soft_wrap=True and an OSError path that prints "Unable to read" to stderr and exits -1); rich/console.py (Console.print_json after print, lazy import of JSON); rich/__init__.py (package-level print_json delegating to get_console(), __all__ unchanged); docs/source/console.rst ("Printing JSON" section, "Low level output" heading appears once); docs/source/reference/json.rst and reference.rst toctree entry; CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added entry; tests/test_json.py with a console styled-output test and a package-level plain-output test. Choices: overflow "none" implemented as Python None because "none" is not a valid OverflowMethod; fraction requires one or more digits. CLI is run as python -m rich.json because python rich/json.py would shadow the stdlib json module. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified.
